function.name: agentic_readme_audit
function.description: Mechanically audit a README against facts.json ground truth ledger to detect fact drift, broken badges, leaked internal jargon, and voice issues.

readme_path.description: Path to the README.md file to audit (default: 'README.md')

facts_file.description: Path to the facts.json ground truth ledger (default: '.agentic-readme/facts.json')

function.name: agentic_readme_ground
function.description: Phase 0 Grounding: Inspect target codebase, run test suite, extract deterministic facts, and create story.yaml and facts.json contracts.

function.name: agentic_readme_produce
function.description: Phase 1 Produce: Generate media assets (Excalidraw diagram, theme-aware SVGs, VHS demo script, video specs) and candidate README from locked contracts.

dir_path.description: Project directory; contracts are read from its .agentic-readme/ (default: '.')

function.name: agentic_readme_verify
function.description: Phase 2 Verify: Run Evaluator-Optimizer loop on generated assets to eliminate fact drift, rendering bugs, and AI slop.

function.name: agentic_readme_run
function.description: Run the complete end-to-end 3-phase pipeline (Ground -> Produce -> Verify) on a repository.

auto_approve.description: Automatically approve Phase 0 contract gate (default: true)
